description: Searches the catalogue's public pages, 24 per page, ranked the way the catalogue on veseljko.hr ranks them. Combine filters (category, group, county, town, occasion, guests, discount) with Croatian search words in "query": the words are read for kinds, places, occasions and guest counts ("fotograf vjenčanje Split", "sala za 150 gostiju", "torta za rođendan Zagreb") and matched by meaning too. Write the words in Croatian; translate the user's request first. Every argument is optional: none lists everything. Returns each page's id, name, category, town, short description, capacity, occasions, badges and address; call get_business with an id for the full page. For the next page, call again with page + 1 and the same seed, so the order stays the same.

county.description: A county or region key from list_places (e.g. "istarska", "dalmacija").

discount.description: true: only pages that give a Veseljko popust on their price list today, a discount only for customers who come from Veseljko.

group.description: Only venues (prostor), event planners (organizator) or other services (partner).

guests.description: How many guests: venues that seat at least about this many.

query.description: Croatian search words, e.g. "bend za vjenčanje", "fotograf Split", "sala za 150 gostiju".

seed.description: The seed a previous call returned, to keep the same order when paging.

name: search_businesses
title: Pretraži katalog (search)
